Ontology_TreatmentAndDesign_prompt.notes: The proteomics experiment described in the PRIDE metadata and Methods section is an affinity purification (IP) study to identify the ERα interactome. While the broader paper explores genetic perturbations (RBDmut) and drug treatments (Tamoxifen, Zotatifin), the specific MS dataset (PXD025018) is a comparison between ERα pulldown and a mock IgG control to identify interacting proteins.
